annotations.title: Get live parcel shipping rates from a US origin

description:
Live parcel rates from a US origin: USPS, UPS, FedEx; DHL Express to DE and AU. Describe the item to estimate the box, or give exact dimensions and weight. Up to five services, each a total with the SMKlog fee inside (itemized only on the checkout receipt). To buy on smklog.com: quote_id to create_checkout_link. Typical prices: get_price_index (free).

Parameter rules:
- weight_lb, length_in, width_in, height_in count only as a set of four above zero, else the box is estimated.
- One label per box: units that fit one box are priced as that box; more boxes or a quantity above 1 sent with exact dimensions: multiple_boxes.
- Over 150 lb, 108 in longest side or 165 in length plus girth, or pallet or freight: mode not_a_parcel.
- product: the item, up to 200 characters; a bare route, weight or question: product_not_recognized.
- from_zip: a real 5-digit US ZIP, else invalid_us_zip.
- to_country: US, CA, GB, DE or AU, else international_unsupported_online; to_zip follows it.
- 80 calls an hour per client.

product.description: Plain-words item description, e.g. "65 inch flat screen TV in original box".

quantity.description: How many of the item ship together.

to_country.description: Two-letter destination country: US (default), CA, GB, DE, AU.

to_zip.description: A 5-digit ZIP for the US, else the country's postal code, e.g. M5V 2T6 (Toronto), SW1A 1AA (London).

name: get_parcel_quote

outputSchema.description: Live rates; when rates is empty, mode says why.

mode.description: parcel_label_ready when rates are listed; otherwise not_a_parcel, multiple_boxes or parcel_restricted

package.description: The packed box the rates were computed for

quote_id.description: Valid 15 minutes; pass it to create_checkout_link to skip a second carrier call. Null when no rate came back or it could not be stored.

rates.description: Up to five services. Not cheapest first: ranked by checkout total in cents plus 175 per business day in transit (30 when none is quoted), lowest first; a rate with a carrier counter price may lead a near-tie within 50 cents or 2 percent. Sort by amount yourself for the cheapest.

amount.description: Checkout total, USD, SMKlog fee inside

delivery_days.description: Business days in transit, if quoted

retail_amount.description: Carrier counter price, USD; 0 when not published

service.description: Service name without the carrier prefix

title: Get live parcel shipping rates from a US origin
